control_need.evidence: I'm not interested in putting together pieces of somebody else's stuff. Because we want to control the primary technology. Because we know that's how you innovate.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: We're not projecting beyond the current quarter obviously. We just don't do that. / I wouldn't want to speculate about those sorts of things, and so I'm going to punt on that one.

trust_propensity.evidence: We are a secretive company. We like to hold what we do to ourselves until it's time to come out and talk about it. / We do look at every app before it goes on. It's a rigorous process.

risk_appetite.evidence: steer your ship into the choppy seas. Look for the rough spots, the problems that seem too big... Whatever you do, don't make the mistake of being too cautious.

self_efficacy.evidence: And so what I had to do was to be the best version of myself. / In terms of the noise, I tune it out because if not, it would just be deafening.

autonomy_need.evidence: I try not to let the urgent take over the day. / Steve taught me well: never to get married to your convictions of yesterday.

intimacy_need.evidence: if you're looking at the phone more than you're looking in somebody's eyes, you're doing the wrong thing. / I felt a responsibility to try to do something... I made that trade-off with my own privacy.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Talking heads critiquing -- this kind of stuff kind of goes through me. It has to, or I wouldn't be able to function. / I try very hard not to take things personal.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: find the real, true empathy that comes from something shared. / The number of emails I'm getting from customers... using their AirPods Pro 2 as a hearing aid are just staggering and heartwarming.

core_models.name: 端到端控制即创新
core_models.rule: 拥有并控制核心底层技术（软硬件+生态）是创新与信任的前提，拒绝拼装他人组件
evidence: Because we want to control the primary technology. Because we know that's how you innovate.
You can call it the seamless integration of hardware and software.

core_models.name: 受控信任生态双边论
core_models.rule: 通过严格审核制造摩擦，换取用户对平台的信任，信任本身即生态价值来源
evidence: this friction is what produces a curated experience for users, that they love and they can go somewhere and be assured that it's safe and trusted.
People don't come to a store if they begin to think that their credit cards can be ripped off.

core_models.name: 面向未来不回望
core_models.rule: 决策以长期未来为锚，刻意不被历史约束，随新证据修正立场
evidence: We don't really look back very much at all in history. We're always focused on the future.
never to get married to your convictions of yesterday. To always, if presented with something new that says you were wrong, admit it and go forward.

core_models.name: IP回报正当化模型
core_models.rule: 平台创造全部商业价值，佣金是对IP与工具的合理回报，免费App通过带流量提供隐性补贴
evidence: we are creating the entire amount of commerce on the store, and we're doing that by focusing on getting the largest audience there.
If we allowed people to link out like that, we would in essence give up our total return on our IP.

heuristics.if: 面对不掌握的具体数据或法律敏感问题
heuristics.then: 承认不熟悉并承诺跟进/回避，绝不即兴给出承诺
heuristics.evidence: Congressman, I'm not familiar with that, but I could follow up with your office on it.

heuristics.if: 被指控垄断或滥用市场地位
heuristics.then: 重构为'激烈竞争'叙事并援引替代平台选择
heuristics.evidence: I would describe it as a street fight for market share in the smartphone business.

heuristics.then: 主动屏蔽情绪、不当作针对个人来处理
heuristics.evidence: In terms of the noise, I tune it out because if not, it would just be deafening.
I actually think it's even more important to engage when there's disagreement.

heuristics.then: 以历史被低估案例（Watch/iPhone）合理化坚持
heuristics.evidence: When the iPhone came out, people said, 'This isn't going to work. It doesn't have a physical keyboard.'

internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说A(帮开发者)-做B(蓄意违令保收入)；财务优先压倒合规，被判'Cook chose poorly'并移送刑事藐视调查

causal_rules.description: 控制欲极高时，倾向拒绝开放/外链/侧载，以'保护生态信任'包装对底层技术与分发的控制
causal_rules.disposition: 封闭生态、抵制外部监管拆解

causal_rules.description: 不确定性容忍偏低时，对未来数字/法律问题一律拒绝预测并承诺跟进以规避承诺风险
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I'm going to punt on that''not familiar, follow up with your office'成固定应答模式；但2018对华乐观表态是罕见破例并致集体诉讼(05-08)

causal_rules.description: 自我效能高+状态敏感低时，对外部批评采取情绪隔离而非防御，维持功能性执行
causal_rules.disposition: 屏蔽噪音、面向未来推进
